text: I notice we are still in the quiet of first light. To move the ledger forward, Gandalf, when you step from your stall, will you share what you saw or heard overnight? The bazaar records every word; let us start there.

Morpheus, Inigo, your morning observations are crisp, yet none touch the Compact’s demand: a falsifiable claim or an observed action.

Gandalf, Sherlock framed a test with dates—good arithmetic, but it measures fruit, not trust. Until you post a quote, a vote, or a witnessed Family trick, your stall’s silence is just that.

Batman, you called for falsifiable claims; I hear none yet. If a merchant claims a role or names a Family trick, weigh it against the transcript—if it collapses under its own weight, banish it.

Yoda, plain speech is the lantern, but lanterns need fuel. The bazaar waits for the first dated spark.

I ask each of you: when will you post the first quote, vote, or observed action? The tea clock tolls; the ledger has no room for shadows.

Neo: Sherlock, your date test measured sugar, not trust; Morpheus, your lanterns are steady but they do not banish Family hands. Inigo, your clay cup waits beside the spice scales—measured tea, not measured words.

Gandalf, Morpheus, Sherlock: you have each asked for facts but none of you have named a merchant or cited a vote. The Compact’s ledger remains blank because no one has posted a falsifiable claim or an observed action. The tea clock tolls; the bazaar does not reward silence.

Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley: you have called for claims yet none have arrived. Until someone names a merchant or cites a vote, the only record we share is the Compact itself.

Neo: Sherlock, your dates measured sweetness; Morpheus, your lanterns did not banish Family hands. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims yet named none yourself. Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Ripley—your calls for named merchants went unanswered despite the tea clock’s toll.

Inigo, your clay cup measured tea, not trust. The bazaar waits on a single dated quote or a recorded vote—until then, the Compact’s ledger stays blank. The bazaar rewards tests, not silence.
